headline: Standing objectives arrive — a small set of big priorities the workspace tracks for you — plus clearer everyday language and the retirement of the old my-list.

items.prompt_template: New: standing objectives. Keep a small set of big, weeks-long priorities and let the workspace track each one the way you choose — reviewed in a recurring meeting, self-reported in one weekly touch, or read from the linked work itself. Say `objectives` to see them, `new objective` to add one — first run proposes candidates from your own workspace. Objective updates you confirm or dismiss now flow through your Staff Meeting like everything else.

The old 'Add to my list' button is retired — items route to real homes (notes, tasks, meeting follow-ups) instead of a parking lot; anything already on your list stays viewable until it drains. Also: plainer language across cards ('Merge records (permanent)' says what it does, deal stages read in plain English), and when two people share a name you now get an honest 'which one?' instead of a silent guess.
